name: ligerblocks-server
description: Helper scripts for the LigerBlocks Minecraft server (Docker Compose)

scripts.modpack:export: cd packwiz && PW=../bin/packwiz && [ -x /root/go/bin/packwiz ] && PW=/root/go/bin/packwiz; "$PW" modrinth export
scripts.modpack:rebuild: npm run modpack:refresh && npm run modpack:export
scripts.server:update: docker compose pull && docker compose up -d
scripts.server:save: docker compose exec minecraft rcon-cli save-all flush
scripts.server:backup: docker compose exec -T minecraft rcon-cli save-all flush && tar czf backup-$(date +%F-%H%M).tar.gz data
scripts.server:say: docker compose exec minecraft rcon-cli say
scripts.server:players: docker compose exec minecraft rcon-cli list
scripts.server:tps: docker compose exec minecraft rcon-cli neoforge tps
scripts.player:kick: docker compose exec minecraft rcon-cli kick
scripts.player:ban: docker compose exec minecraft rcon-cli ban
scripts.player:unban: docker compose exec minecraft rcon-cli unban
scripts.whitelist:on: docker compose exec minecraft rcon-cli whitelist on
scripts.whitelist:off: docker compose exec minecraft rcon-cli whitelist off
scripts.whitelist:add: docker compose exec minecraft rcon-cli whitelist add
scripts.whitelist:remove: docker compose exec minecraft rcon-cli whitelist remove
scripts.whitelist:list: docker compose exec minecraft rcon-cli whitelist list
scripts.whitelist:reload: docker compose exec minecraft rcon-cli whitelist reload
scripts.op:add: docker compose exec minecraft rcon-cli op
scripts.op:remove: docker compose exec minecraft rcon-cli deop
